rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a panicked, frantic manner.

example.english: I frantically rushed into the house, only to realize I had forgotten my keys.
example.traditional: 我慌慌張張咁走入屋，先發現自己漏咗帶鎖匙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong1 fong1 zoeng1 zoeng1 gam3 zau2 jap6 uk1 sin1 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 lau6 zo2 daai3 so2 si4

rows.note: Use this when the frantic action involves desperate, all-out effort rather than mainly panic.

example.english: They frantically swam and finally reached the shore.
example.traditional: 佢哋拼命咁游水，終於游到岸邊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ping3 ming6 gam3 jau4 seoi2 zung1 jyu1 jau4 dou3 ngon6 bin1

rows.note: Use this when someone is frantic because they are flustered and struggling to manage their actions.

example.english: I frantically fumbled around looking for tools when I made a cake for the first time.
example.traditional: 我第一次整蛋糕，手忙腳亂咁周圍搵工具。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zing2 daan6 gou1 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6 gam3 zau1 wai4 wan2 gung1 geoi6
